details:
Cosrx advance snail 92 cream. 
Finding a moisturizer that best suits your skin can be quite challenging. I have tried a number of moisturizers but I have really fallen in love with this. 
I use this in different ways . So let me break it down. 🐌 I use it as an intense hydrator where I slather it all over my damp face when it feels super dry. Wait for like 20 mins.  And after that I go about doing my night routine. 🐌 I use it as a sleeping mask, when I take 1:1 of this and mix it with a sleeping mask at the end of my routine. Or I use this alone as a thick layer after a different moisturizer as a sleeping mask on its own. 🐌I use this as a base to mix in and experiment other products. For example if I do not want to use an oil by itself , then I mix it in with this. 🐌I use this on my eyes and lips too as an eye cream/ lip mask. 
This is a very hydrating moisturizer and also very safe as it is made of minimal ingredients. Cosrx claims "The Advanced Snail all in one Cream that supports the natural regeneration of damaged skin to reduce the appearance of wrinkles”. I can strongly agree with this. I am an acid queen 👸🏻 and I am always looking for gentler products that help with cell regeneration. I believe this has done so much of justice in strengthening my skin barrier. 
My only pet peeve about this is that the lid peels (swipe left) and it tends to get into the cream at times. So keeping the rim of the tub and cream away from these black pieces can be a little annoying.
